exposure: Mode of delivery (primary cesarean section vs. normal spontaneous vaginal delivery)
outcome: Need for oxygen support during delivery
finding: COVID-19 infection was associated with increased rates of obstetric complications and cesarean delivery, and a positive correlation was observed between COVID-19 severity and postpartum maternal condition.
mod_finding: The PCR-positive group had significantly higher rates of primary and prelabor cesarean deliveries, and severe/critical COVID-19 infection rates were higher in the primary cesarean group.
